Kevin: Kicking off feature-flag ramp for model_route_v3 in 10m. Plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% over ~30m. Pin model v2 for traffic that hits the old routing. Will post rollout checkpoints. :rocket:
Deploy-Bot: deploy triggered by kevin; job id 98765. ETA 10m. Will post health pings every 2m.
Jamie: Quick Q — what's our SLO for p99 latency during the ramp? Also rollback thresholds?
Kevin: p99 SLO is 220ms for routing API. Rollback if error rate delta > 0.8% absolute or p99 increase > 120ms for two consecutive windows (2m).
Susan: Noted. Can we set a soft hold at 10% if latency drifts but error rate is stable? Suggest auto-hold with manual resume.
Kevin: yes — adding an auto-hold on p99 delta > 80ms but error delta < 0.5% so we don't overreact. Manual resume required.
Mike: Adding the observability checklist:
```
metric: api.routing.latency.p99
baseline_window: last_15m
compare_window: active_2m
alert_if: compare - baseline > 0.12s for 2 windows
```
I also pushed a quick log filter to the canary stack: `service:model-router tag:route_v3`
Jamie: How are we pinning v2? Need the exact FF toggle to ensure no stray traffic.
Kevin: Pin via toggle: `model_route_selector = {"pin_v2": true, "cohort_percent": 0}`. I'll run this before first shift.
Deploy-Bot: health ping: canary[0] OK, canary[1] OK, canary[2] WARN (latency +90ms).
Susan: Seeing WARN on canary[2] too. Not in error rate yet. Hold at 1% and notifying infra to keep an eye on GPU queue.
Kevin: Holding ramp at 1%. Moving to manual check. Jamie/Susan — please confirm logs look healthy.
Jamie: Logs look fine, no increase in 5xx. GPU queue slight uptick but within burst capacity. Recommend continue to 10% after another 2m if stable. :+1:
Deploy-Bot: operator action required: manual_resume to continue ramp. Use `/deploy-bot resume 2799999999` to proceed.`
